entities.name: Lebanese nationalism
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Lebanese nationalism is a nationalist ideology that emphasises Lebanon's history, sovereignty and identity, in which it considers the Lebanese people as separate from the rest of its neighbours and strives to maintain Lebanon as an independent nation-state.
